subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction drop aborted/error assistant tool-call turns with missing results before summarization, matching existing prompt-send sanitizer behavior, or should OpenClaw instead preserve them with a synthetic recovery result?
rationale: Both choices are plausible session-state policy: dropping avoids strict-provider rejection and fabricated tool output, while synthesizing preserves more conversation shape but can mislead summaries and has open product-design implications.

options.title: Accept drop policy and land
options.body: Approve the PR's existing approach after exact-head review because it reuses the established repair helper and prevents strict-provider compaction failures with bounded context loss.

options.title: Require synthetic recovery design
options.body: Ask for a different PR that preserves aborted turns with explicit synthetic error results and focused proof that summaries and providers handle that shape safely.

options.title: Pause for broader session repair plan
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want compaction, prompt-send, replay, and doctor recovery redesigned together instead of accepting a narrow compaction fix.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy and land
recommendation.body: Approve the PR's existing approach after exact-head review because it reuses the established repair helper and prevents strict-provider compaction failures with bounded context loss.
